data.name: Pyrogreen
data.description: Pyrogreen Energy is the biochar brand of Wuxi Powermax Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese manufacturer of biomass pyrolysis and carbonization equipment (screw-conveyor, rotary kiln, and fixed-bed systems) based in Wuxi, Jiangsu. The company provides turnkey biochar production systems from 50 kg/hr to 5 MT/hr and offers dMRV and carbon-credit registration support under standards such as Verra, Puro.earth, and Isometric.
